liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (4 reviews, 1 other source): Band members sing unusual backing vocals around the 17-minute mark of Lovelight; Lovelight runs over twenty-six minutes, with Phil's bass playing singled out as outstanding [1][3][4][6][12]
- **Good Lovin'** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer singles out Good Lovin' as excellent; Good Lovin' is praised, with Phil's playing singled out [1][5][11]
- **Dancing in the Streets** (1 review): Reviewer ranks Dancing perhaps as good as the famous version from two weeks earlier [11]
- **Easy Wind** (1 review): Easy Wind is praised as intense, rolling along before returning to the verses despite its slow tempo [7]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Only a short bridge leads from China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider [10]

## The recordings

- **gd70-02-27.sbd.clugston.2191.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 16 songs; 128 min; rated 4/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the bass is turned up loud in the soundboard mix; Sound is very good for 1970; Sound is rated excellent, with Phil's bass prominent and the band harmonies strong [3][5][8][10]
- **gd1970-02-27.sbd.miller.28833.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 14 songs; 138 min; rated 3.69/5 by 13 [2]

## Around the show

- David Gans played the Not Fade Away into Lovelight on one of his Dead Hour radio programs [4]
- Reviewer thinks this may be the best Lovelight they have heard, though the show has some sloppy spots [4]
- Only the Fillmore East shows from two weeks earlier rival the Family Dog run, in this reviewer's view [6]
- Reviewer prefers this show to the first night at Selland Arena, Fresno in 1974 [8]
- Reviewer finds this three-night run more routine than inspired, compared with the Fillmore East run [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-02-27.sbd.clugston.2191.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Master soundboard reel to cassette to DAT to CDR, passed via Scott Clugston to abgd and etree [1]
- **gd1970-02-27.sbd.miller.28833.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat/0 (48k) D [2]. Also: The master reel ran out right at the end, cutting off the last couple of seconds; Black Peter, Casey Jones and Cumberland Blues are patched in from an earlier circulating soundboard copy (shnid 2191); The very end of Lovelight is cut off in this transfer [2][12]
